title: Fisherman’s Wharf & Pier 39 Food Tour - Includes Full Meal, 3 hrs
blurb:
Step into the heart of San Francisco's historic waterfront with our engaging walking tour. Wander through the city’s legendary wharfs, piers, and docks while uncovering its maritime past and indulging in its diverse culinary offerings. From the fresh flavors of Fisherman’s Wharf to the sweet delights of Ghirardelli Square, this tour blends history, food, and iconic sights into an unforgettable adventure.

Highlights:
+ Full meal provided
+ Intimate group settings
+ Discover the salty tales of San Francisco’s maritime past
+ Taste San Francisco’s iconic sourdough bread
+ Meet the lively sea lions in their natural habitat
+ Marvel at the infamous island prison of Alcatraz
+ Sample the sweet richness of Ghirardelli chocolate
+ Visit a hidden fisherman’s chapel steeped in history

Join us for an unforgettable journey that blends culture, cuisine, and iconic landmarks!
